question: Who is the illustrator that illustrated the least amount of cards? List the format of play of the cards that he/she illustrated.
evidence: format of the cards refers to format; illustrator refers to artist; the least amount of cards refers to MIN(artist)
clarification: Also keep rows that have no matching legalities record.
gold: SELECT T1.artist, T2.format FROM cards AS T1 LEFT JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid GROUP BY T1.artist ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) ASC LIMIT 1
gold0: SELECT T1.artist, T2.format FROM cards AS T1 INNER JOIN legalities AS T2 ON T2.uuid = T1.uuid GROUP BY T1.artist ORDER BY COUNT(T1.id) ASC LIMIT 1

c.request:
Who is the illustrator that illustrated the least amount of cards? List the format of play of the cards that he/she illustrated.
Evidence: format of the cards refers to format; illustrator refers to artist; the least amount of cards refers to MIN(artist)
Also keep rows that have no matching legalities record.
c.sql: SELECT DISTINCT l.format FROM cards c LEFT JOIN legalities l ON l.uuid = c.uuid WHERE c.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE artist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY artist ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1)

b.request: Which illustrator (artist) has illustrated the fewest cards, and what are the formats of play for their cards, using a left join from cards to legalities so cards with no legalities record are still included?
b.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.artist, l.format FROM cards c LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.artist = (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE artist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY artist ORDER BY COUNT(*) ASC LIMIT 1)

d.request: Who is the illustrator that illustrated the fewest cards, and what are the play formats of the cards they illustrated, including cards that have no matching record in the legalities table (i.e., keeping those rows rather than dropping them)?
d.sql: SELECT DISTINCT c.artist, l.format FROM cards c LEFT JOIN legalities l ON c.uuid = l.uuid WHERE c.artist IN (SELECT artist FROM cards WHERE artist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY artist HAVING COUNT(*) = (SELECT MIN(cnt) FROM (SELECT COUNT(*) AS cnt FROM cards WHERE artist IS NOT NULL GROUP BY artist)))
